name: film.splash
description: Film Studio: judge whether a splash plate or title card for the Jacob Rodgers coach cut meets the Pirates red/black brand system and coach-grade restraint before it renders into an export. Jev scores the typed design record (palette measurements, typography, layout, claims); it never sees pixels. ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED until calibrate runs against settled guardian reviews.

brand_alignment.instructions: Given the typed design record (colors, measured palette shares, fonts, layout), how well does this card match the confirmed Pirates identity: black ground, red single accent, bone text, Archivo Black display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono source lines, flat fills, no gradients, one accent per frame?
criteria: off-brand: wrong palette or template-stock look
loose: right idea, wrong details (gradients, multiple accents, off-palette)
aligned: palette and typography correct, minor spacing issues
locked: indistinguishable from the brand file's reference grammar

coach_grade_restraint.instructions: The card reads as a serious recruiting artifact: no effects, no music references, no motivational slogans, no stock-sport clichés. High values mean strong restraint.

claim_accuracy.instructions: Every word on the card is true and checkable: name, jersey number, positions, class year, school, and link. Any unverifiable or inflated claim drives this down.

template_stock_risk.instructions: This could be mistaken for a Canva/template sport graphic: gradients, glow effects, drop shadows, clipart flames, centered everything-default look. High values mean high risk.

rules.reason: claims on the card lack evidence pointers; actual truth is enforced by the ledger layer (every number maps 1:1 to a ledger row) -- this gate only catches unsourced text
template-stock look is the exact thing this studio exists to avoid
card reads as hype rather than evaluation material -- pull effects before rendering
meets the confirmed Pirates red/black system and coach-grade restraint (provisional threshold pending calibration)
